stories.summary: Science Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats Sep 23, 2026 We’re introducing a new life sciences research group and laboratory at Anthropic. stories.headline: Fixing the Portobello Police Station Clock
stories.summary: Fixing the Portobello Police Station Clock Written on 11th April 2026 I got a message from a friend today which read along the lines of "I know we were going to meet in Edinburgh today, but do you fancy meeting in Portobello instead and trying to fix the clock in the old police station with me? " I don't know about you, but clambering around the dusty nineteenth century clock tower of an abandoned police station sounds an ideal way to spend a Saturday afternoon to me, so I jumped at the chance.

stories.headline: VSCode's SSH Agent Is Bananas (2025)
stories.summary: Author Name Thomas Ptacek @tqbf @tqbf We’re interested in getting integrated into the flow VSCode uses to do remote editing over SSH, because everybody is using VSCode now, and, in particular, they’re using forks of VSCode that generate code with LLMs.  ”hallucination” is what we call it when LLMs get code wrong; “engineering” is what we call it when people do.

stories.headline: ArXiv receives multiyear commitments to support it as an independent nonprofit
stories.summary: arXiv receives Multiyear Philanthropic Commitments to Support Its Launch as an Independent Nonprofit By Kat Boboris · September 23 rd 2026 arXiv is pleased to announce that three leading philanthropic organizations have provided multimillion-dollar support for arXiv.  These new multiyear philanthropic commitments from Simons Foundation International, XTX Markets, and Siegel Family Endowment will support platform development, organizational capacity, and overall provide foundational support to arXiv’s establishment as an independent nonprofit.
